name: Red White Cinderella
source:
After an accident, you wake up to a strange, unfamiliar setting. Transported to the land of Pertiwi, you found yourself as a crown princess candidate of the kingdom! With two handsome princes in tow, you have to decide who will be your King. Discover a fairy tale world of epic proportions in this modern take on classic South-East Asian folklore! 

[From [url=https://memoriesinteractive.com/story/red-white-cinderella/]Memories Interactive[/url]]
translation:
一场事故后，你醒来时发现自己身处一个陌生的环境中。传送到珀蒂维之地，你发现自己成为了王国的王储公主候选人！有两位英俊的王子在身边，你必须决定谁将成为你的国王。在这个经典东南亚民间传说的现代演绎中探索史诗般的童话世界！

[来自[url=https://memoriesinteractive.com/story/red-white-cinderella/]Memories Interactive[/url]]
